sections.heading: Description
lines: Rocky Field is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as a Telluric field and can be randomly found in the Grand Dream Stadium during the tournament.

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Rock-type moves → 1.5x boost.
“The field strengthened the attack!”
Pokémon with raised Defense cannot flinch and gain the effects of Bulletproof. Pokémon hiding behind a Substitute gain the effects of Bulletproof as well.
“[Pokémon] won't flinch because of its bolstered Defenses!”
“[Pokémon] hid behind a rock to dodge the attack!”
Pokémon with the Hotshot ability bypass the Bulletproof effect granted by this field, although as of V14.0.22, this interaction isn't listed in the in-game Field Notes.
If a Pokémon misses a physical contact move, it takes damage equal to 1/8 max HP.
“[Pokémon] hit a rock instead!”
Rock Head protects the bearer from this damage.
Gorilla Tactics double this damage to 1/4 Max HP.
If a Pokémon flinches, it takes damage equal to 1/4 max HP, unless it has one of the abilities Magic Guard, Steadfast or Sturdy.
“[Pokémon] was knocked into a rock!”
As of V14.0.22, Magic Guard isn't listed in the in-game Field Notes.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Buffed Abilities:
Coal Furnace activates and raises the user's Speed by 1 stage at the end of each turn.
As of V14.0.22, this interaction isn't listed in the in-game Field Notes.
Rocky Payload increases damage of the user's Rock-type moves by 2x instead of 1.5x.
Nerfed Abilities:
Long Reach decreases the bearer's Accuracy by 0.9x.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Damage Modifiers: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Rock Smash → 2x boost.
“SMASH'D!”
Bulldoze, Earthquake, Magnitude, Rock Climb, Strength → 1.5x boost, Rock sub-typing.
“The rocks strengthened the attack!”
Accelerock → 1.5x boost.
“The rocks strengthened the attack!”
Other moves: Buffed Moves:
Arenite Wall always lasts 8 turns and can be set regardless of weather.
Rock Polish boosts the user's Speed by 3 stages.
Stealth Rock damage is doubled.
Field-dependent moves & Abilities:
Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Rock.
Camouflage changes the user's type to Rock.
Nature Power becomes Rock Smash.
Secret Power may cause the target to Flinch.
Shelter halves damage from Rock-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Rock.

sections.heading: Items
lines: Telluric Seed raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage but damages them with Stealth Rocks.

sections.heading: Notes
lines: Prior to V14, the move Splintered Stormshards generated this field for 2 turns.
“The field was devastated!”
